# kkp_cluster_kubeconfig (Data Source)

The admin kubeconfig of a cluster, for the `kubernetes` and `helm` providers. It ends up in state, so treat the state as a secret. Needs an editor or owner token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kkp_cluster_kubeconfig" "staging" {
  cluster_id = kkp_cluster.staging.id
}

provider "kubernetes" {
  config_path = local_sensitive_file.kubeconfig.filename
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  content  = data.kkp_cluster_kubeconfig.staging.kubeconfig
  filename = "${path.module}/kubeconfig"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig YAML.
